nodes.label: Session Start Protocol
nodes.rationale: Four short state files (PENDING, MEMORY, index, progress) are read in full every session so context is rebuilt cheaply; the 4,700-line plan is deliberately NOT re-read end to end because length is a tax on every session.

nodes.label: Session End Protocol
nodes.rationale: State files are updated in the SAME commit as the work so the ledger cannot drift from the code; MEMORY only takes durable facts, index only structural changes.

nodes.label: No Trading Paths (absent code, not disabled features)
nodes.rationale: F&O, intraday, leverage and LAS are absent code paths rather than flagged-off features, so there is no override flag that a bug or a prompt could flip.

nodes.label: No Autonomous Execution
nodes.rationale: Every order requires fresh human approval; standing auto-execute rules are forbidden because the approval gate IS the safety model.

nodes.label: Single-User, No Multi-Tenancy
nodes.rationale: No accounts, no sharing; features that make recommendations easier to share are refused because they would turn a personal agent into unlicensed advice.

nodes.label: funded_status Firewall (no catch-up behaviour)
nodes.rationale: A sizing or risk function that learns how funded the owner is would start taking more risk to catch up; the constraint is enforced by an import-graph architecture test (Task 10) rather than by the type system, because a branded number is still assignable to a plain number parameter.

nodes.label: Audit Immutability (append-only + RLS)
nodes.rationale: Triggers must cover UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE (Postgres does not fire DELETE triggers on TRUNCATE) plus RLS, so the audit trail cannot be rewritten by any path.

nodes.label: Money Is Never a Float
nodes.rationale: Branded bigint paise/cents only; float arithmetic on money silently loses or invents rupees and cannot be audited.

nodes.label: Never Invent a Number to Close a Gap
nodes.rationale: A PRD total that disagrees with the line items is a data question for the owner, not a tuning exercise; the resolution is the owner's real statement recorded as a true-up item, never a tuned constant.

nodes.label: Never Widen a Test Band to Make Red Go Green
nodes.rationale: A band may only move after proving the model is right and the band's premise wrong, and then it is surfaced to the owner rather than edited silently.

nodes.label: TDD With Mutation-Checked Guard Rails
nodes.rationale: A guard-rail test that hard-codes both sides of its comparison tests nothing; one side must be derived from the real data structure and the test mutation-checked to prove it can go red.

nodes.label: Fix-on-Touch for Deferred Minors
nodes.rationale: The plan has only one fix wave, which can absorb a handful of cross-cutting items but not an accumulated backlog, so a minor in a file you are editing is fixed in the same commit.

nodes.label: The Plan's Reference Code Is a Sketch, Not Truth
nodes.rationale: Tasks 2, 3, 5 and 6 each shipped a real defect in the plan's own snippet — one failing its own acceptance criterion by construction — so briefs give acceptance criteria and interfaces, and an implementer that contradicts the brief with working arithmetic is doing its job.

nodes.label: Subagent-Driven Execution Model
nodes.rationale: implementer to task reviewer to fix loop (<=5 rounds) to scoped re-review to ledger entry; briefs are stale on the Db interface so every dispatch must restate it verbatim.

nodes.label: Kolkata Property Is Not an Optimization Target
nodes.rationale: Never recommend selling or renting it; in the model it is a liability line and never a position, so it structurally cannot reach the allocation engine.
